subject.title: [Feature]: 3 architecture improvements — bootstrap relevance, incremental compaction, observation extraction

question: Which part of this broad architecture request should OpenClaw core own first, and which parts should move to existing plugin/context-engine trackers?
rationale: Current main only partially covers the request, and choosing a generic bootstrap relevance algorithm or promoting observation extraction into core requires maintainer architecture intent.

options.title: Split Into Focused Tracks
options.body: Create or confirm narrow trackers for bootstrap relevance, compaction architecture, and observation extraction before any implementation PR is queued.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the parent architecture discussion and block automated repair until one track is prioritized.

options.title: Supersede After Relinking
options.body: Close this issue only after bootstrap and compaction are fully covered by narrower open items and observation extraction is confirmed outside core.

recommendation.title: Split Into Focused Tracks
recommendation.body: Create or confirm narrow trackers for bootstrap relevance, compaction architecture, and observation extraction before any implementation PR is queued.
